nodes.description: mapping(address=>uint256) private _rOwned; internal reflection balances used for all accounting.
mapping(address=>uint256) private _tOwned; declared but unused in the transfer path.
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) private _allowances; ERC20 allowance storage.
mapping(address=>bool) private _isExcludedFromFee; addresses exempt from fees and cooldown.
mapping(address=>bool) private bots; blocklist checked inside _transfer.
mapping(address=>uint) private cooldown; per-address last-buy timestamp gate.
uint256 private _rTotal; total reflections, decreased on every fee reflection.
uint256 private _tFeeTotal; cumulative fees taken.
uint256 private _feeAddr1; reflection/tax fee percentage, set to 0 inside _transfer.
uint256 private _feeAddr2; team fee percentage, set to 10 inside _transfer.
address payable private _feeAddrWallet1; controls manualswap/manualsend.
address payable private _feeAddrWallet2; ETH fee recipient.
IUniswapV2Router02 private uniswapV2Router; set in openTrading, used for swaps and liquidity.
address private uniswapV2Pair; created pool, gates fee logic in _transfer.
bool private tradingOpen; set true at the end of openTrading.
bool private inSwap; reentrancy guard flag used by lockTheSwap.
bool private swapEnabled; enables automatic contract-token swaps.
bool private cooldownEnabled; toggled by setCooldownEnabled/openTrading.
uint256 private _maxTxAmount; buy size cap, lowered in openTrading.
address private _owner; Ownable owner used by onlyOwner and renounceOwnership.
function transfer(address recipient,uint256 amount) public; forwards _msgSender() to _transfer.
function transferFrom(address sender,address recipient,uint256 amount) public; moves tokens then decreases allowance.
function approve(address spender,uint256 amount) public; writes _allowances via _approve.
function _transfer(address from,address to,uint256 amount) private; core routing, fee setup, cooldown and swap trigger before balances are written.
function swapTokensForEth(uint256 tokenAmount) private lockTheSwap; approves the router and swaps contract tokens for ETH.
function sendETHToFee(uint256 amount) private; forwards contract ETH to _feeAddrWallet2.
function openTrading() external onlyOwner; sets router, creates pair, adds liquidity and flips trading flags.
function manualswap() external; requires caller == _feeAddrWallet1 then swaps full contract balance.
function manualsend() external; requires caller == _feeAddrWallet1 then sends all contract ETH to fees.
function nonosquare(address[] memory bots_) public onlyOwner; loops over the supplied array adding blocklisted bots.
function delBot(address notbot) public onlyOwner; removes an address from the blocklist.
function _tokenTransfer(address sender,address recipient,uint256 amount) private; thin wrapper delegating to _transferStandard.
function _transferStandard(address sender,address recipient,uint256 tAmount) private; computes values and updates _rOwned balances, team and fee.
function _takeTeam(uint256 tTeam) private; converts team amount to reflections and credits the contract.
function _reflectFee(uint256 rFee,uint256 tFee) private; subtracts rFee from _rTotal and accrues _tFeeTotal.
function _getValues(uint256 tAmount) private view; derives r/t amounts from the mutable _feeAddr1/_feeAddr2 percentages.
function setCooldownEnabled(bool onoff) external onlyOwner; toggles the cooldown gate.
function renounceOwnership() public virtual onlyOwner; sets _owner to address(0).
msg.sender (via _msgSender()); attacker-controlled caller of every external entry point.
block.timestamp; used for cooldown checks, swap deadlines and liquidity deadline.
external call uniswapV2Router.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens with deadline block.timestamp; control transfers to an arbitrary router set by the owner.
_feeAddrWallet2.transfer(amount); raw ETH push to an external address, can revert or reenter.
external payable uniswapV2Router.addLiquidityETH{value: address(this).balance}(...); sends the whole contract ETH balance out.
external call IUniswapV2Factory(...).createPair(address(this), WETH()); result is trusted without validation.
address from; transfer sender parameter of _transfer.
address to; transfer recipient parameter of _transfer.
uint256 amount; transfer amount parameter of _transfer, checked against _maxTxAmount.
uint256 contractTokenBalance = balanceOf(address(this)); amount pushed to the router inside _transfer.
address sender; debit side parameter of _transferStandard.
address recipient; credit side parameter of _transferStandard.
uint256 tAmount; raw transfer amount parameter of _transferStandard.
uint256 tTeam; team fee amount passed into _takeTeam.
uint256 tokenAmount; amount approved and swapped in swapTokensForEth.

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the sender into _transfer by transfer().
msg.sender is the spender used when decreasing the allowance in transferFrom().
msg.sender becomes the allowance owner in approve().
msg.sender flows as the from address into _transfer.
manualswap authorization compares msg.sender to _feeAddrWallet1.
manualsend authorization compares msg.sender to _feeAddrWallet1.
renounceOwnership onlyOwner compares msg.sender to _owner.
block.timestamp gates the per-recipient cooldown and writes cooldown[to].
block.timestamp is used as the swap deadline passed to the router.
block.timestamp is used as the addLiquidityETH deadline in openTrading.
transfer() calls _transfer.
transferFrom() calls _transfer before adjusting the allowance.
transferFrom() calls _approve via the internal path.
swapTokensForEth is invoked from _transfer before any balance state is written.
sendETHToFee is invoked from _transfer after the swap but before balances are settled.
_transfer finishes by delegating to _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer delegates to _transferStandard.
_transferStandard fetches r/t amounts from _getValues.
_transferStandard disburses the team fee via _takeTeam.
_transferStandard reflects the fee via _reflectFee.
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth, swapping the entire contract balance.
manualsend calls sendETHToFee, pushing all contract ETH out.
openTrading calls addLiquidityETH with the contract balance.
openTrading calls createPair through the factory.
swapTokensForEth makes the external router swap call that can reenter _transfer.
sendETHToFee performs a raw ETH transfer to the fee wallet.
nonosquare writes attacker-supplied addresses into the bots mapping under onlyOwner.
delBot clears a blocklist entry under onlyOwner.
_transfer reads bots[from] and bots[to] to gate transfers.
_transfer writes cooldown[to] from block.timestamp.
_transfer resets the mutable fee percentage _feeAddr1.
_transfer sets the mutable fee percentage _feeAddr2.
_transfer enforces amount <= _maxTxAmount.
_transfer compares from/to against uniswapV2Pair to decide fee and swap paths.
_transfer consults _isExcludedFromFee for from/to.
_transfer reads inSwap to avoid recursive swaps.
_transfer reads swapEnabled before swapping contract tokens.
approve writes the amount into _allowances.
_transferStandard debits/credits _rOwned with SafeMath sub/add results.
_takeTeam adds rTeam to _rOwned[address(this)].
_reflectFee subtracts rFee from _rTotal.
_reflectFee accumulates tFee into _tFeeTotal.
_getValues reads the mutable _feeAddr1 tax percentage.
_getValues reads the mutable _feeAddr2 team percentage.
openTrading assigns the router to uniswapV2Router.
openTrading stores the created pair in uniswapV2Pair.
openTrading sets tradingOpen to true.
openTrading enables swapEnabled.
openTrading enables cooldownEnabled.
openTrading lowers _maxTxAmount.
setCooldownEnabled toggles the cooldown flag under onlyOwner.
renounceOwnership sets _owner to address(0), permanently disabling onlyOwner functions.
parameter from is consumed by _transfer.
parameter to is consumed by _transfer.
parameter amount is consumed and capped by _transfer.
local contractTokenBalance is derived inside _transfer and sent to the swap.
parameter sender is debited inside _transferStandard.
parameter recipient is credited inside _transferStandard.
parameter tAmount feeds the value computation in _transferStandard.
local tTeam is credited to the contract in _takeTeam.
parameter tokenAmount is approved and swapped in swapTokensForEth.

normalization_plan.reason: Local parameter from has no independent identity outside _transfer and should be folded into it.
Local parameter to only exists to route the transfer inside _transfer.
Local parameter amount is validated and forwarded solely inside _transfer.
Temporary balance snapshot computed and immediately consumed by _transfer's swap branch.
Debit-side parameter used only in _transferStandard's balance update.
Credit-side parameter used only in _transferStandard's balance update.
Raw amount parameter consumed only by _transferStandard's value computation.
Local tTeam is only a carrier into _takeTeam and should be merged into it.
Local parameter drives the approve plus router swap inside swapTokensForEth.
